content:
🏆 忘却前夜第4届N厨杯圆满结束！让我们恭喜以下名列前茅的选手们：

🥇 冠军：维克多
🥈 亚军：黄金熊
🥉 季军：空乏
🏅 四强：KaDe
🏅 六强：伏克丝
🏅 六强：不知尘世

感谢主办方在超长赛事流程中的付出！
希望未来会有更多的守密人报名或观看这场本着“输赢不重要，快乐最重要”宗旨的赛事活动，一起期待下一届N厨杯的到来吧<:Lily_wow:1356084702468899117> ！
愿银钥指引前路。

——✦——✦—— ✦✦✦ ——✦——✦——

🏆 The 4th 「N」′s Chef Cup of Morimens has officially wrapped up! Let's give a big round of applause to our top finishers:

🥇 Champion: 维克多
🥈 Runner-up: 黄金熊
🥉 Third Place: 空乏
🏅 Top 4: KaDe
🏅 Top 6: 伏克丝
🏅 Top 6: 不知尘世

Huge thanks to the organizers for all the hard work put into this marathon event.
Hope more Keepers will sign up or tune in next time. With the motto "Winning or losing isn't important, having fun is!", looking forward to the next 「N」′s Chef Cup!
May the Silver Key light our path.
